Attached: 1 image

openGym v1.4.5 brings faster workout logging and cross-platform wearable sync to the open-source fitness tracker. 🏋️

- Log sets from the Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, or Android notifications
- Unified Apple Watch, Wear OS, and Garmin apps with synced rest timers
- New Circuits, AMRAP, EMOM, and Tabata modes

Available soon on PikaPods:
https://github.com/DuarteSantos8/openGym/releases/tag/v1.4.5
https://pikapods.com/pods?run=opengym

#opensource #ownyourdata
